input.summary: Cap set at greater of 12 months' fees under the Agreement and all Order Forms and USD 1,000,000; payment carve-out broadened to amounts due.
input.comment: [Playbook] "Fees" is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the cap is illusory; we set it at the greater of twelve months' fees under the Agreement and all Order Forms and USD 1,000,000, and align the payment carve-out to all amounts due. Excluded Claims (confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) remain outside the cap.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000
